The reference image confirms Alternaria stem canker shows dark grayish-brown to black stem discoloration near the base, with a transition zone.

- **Slight difference**: Test image shows lesion higher on the stem (not at soil line), but stem cankers can develop at any node
- The characteristic dark stem darkening and hanging dead wilted leaves (girdling effect) aligns strongly with Alternaria stem canker
